_about: Longshore sandbars by area (area.py _bars): each beach's crest distances from the waterline (m) found from Sentinel-2 L2A calm days' water colour, 2023-26 scenes, profiles every 50 m along ~3.6 km round 'at' (lat, lon); only crests within 400 m and seen on half the profiles or more. Crest depths are a rule, not measured: the first bar 1.2 m, the second 2.2 m below mean sea level. 'clear': circles (lat, lon, metres) kept free, a harbour's mouth whose moles aren't in the breakwater tiles. The owner, 20.11.2026: 'build B,C,D,E', then 'Yes, add the bars'.

lielupes-ieteka.note: Shoals (20.11.2026) from Sentinel-2's calm colour over the mouth, the median of many scenes, contoured as depth caps; river channels and vegetation uncapped. Scale set by the owner's "Depth there knee deep in lielupe usually" (the riding area's median 0.50 m); the 1.0 m cap left out: the satellite sees ~1.5 m here, unverified.

gauja.note: Shoals (20.11.2026) from Sentinel-2's calm colour over the mouth, the median of many scenes, contoured as depth caps; river channels and vegetation uncapped. Its own scale; the riding area's median 1.08 m, the owner's "Waist deep" (an independent check).

svetciems.crest_note: The bars' tops below mean sea level, for survey.py's scale (the owner, 20.11.2026: 'they dry at low water, around -0.3').

crest: measured at Salacgriva (6 km), Copernicus +0.29 m beyond it: 890 pixels

berzciems.note: The owner's outlines (20.11.2026: "i marked all sandbars and behind it lagoons"; then "my marked region not exact region of sandbanks. I marked area where they are only"): inside them the banks from Sentinel-2's calm colour, scaled on the brightest sand as +0.25 m ("Usually bank appears at 20-30cm water level") and the outside water as 2.4 m (the lagoon, darker than deep water behind the bar, can't anchor it), contoured at -0.25 (from the unsmoothed depths, water there 30 % of scenes or more) / 0.1 / 0.3 / 0.6 m; the lagoons 0.12 m. Reeds and stones left out. Lagoons widened out to the banks (the owner, 20.11.2026: "Shallow all across": the outlines had stopped ~70 m from the reeds, the depth tiles' 2-3 m between): each row's water from the reeds or land to the first bank cell within 450 m. The banks redrawn (the owner, 20.11.2026, the map: "Bank is shallower than lagoon, raise it. Also is it correct? its like straight line. looks unrealistic"): the outlines grown 150 m into the sea before contouring, so the satellite's own edge is the bank's face (it had been the outline's straight line); the contours' depths raised above the lagoon's, the shapes kept: -0.25 / -0.15 / -0.05 / 0.05 (were -0.25 / 0.1 / 0.3 / 0.6). The lagoons then filled again to the redrawn banks (+18 cells). The banks now the satellite's bed itself (beds/berzciems, the owner, 20.11.2026: "this is what we need to implement in our sandbank", then "Yes, do A"): its 10 m depths on the same anchors in place of the 25 contour shapes; the lagoons kept. The lagoons filled again to the bed's bank (+52 cells, 6 ha).
